summary.headline: 99215 share 27% vs 5% expected, but sampled charts do not show recoverable overpayment
summary.rationale: 1000000127 billed 99215 on 26.9% of 2,409 claims against an expected 5.1% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score 18.41; plain z-score vs peers 3.26). 41% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 29 claims. Of 4 documented 99215 claims, 1 (25%) were documented below the billed level, against 45% for the comparison providers. Note checks on 29 returned notes (share showing each sign): problems 34%, late 17%, unsigned 0%, data 21%. No audit trail was received. 26 of 26 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. The evidence does not support a call either way yet. Examples: C0068647: billed 99215; documented MDM level moderate, minutes not recorded. C0068239: billed 99215, patient aged 54 with 0 chronic condition(s). C0068377: billed 99215, patient aged 46 with 0 chronic condition(s).
next_steps: 29 charts came back but do not settle it: request a targeted sample of 99215 charts, starting with C0068647, C0068239, C0068377.
Re-check after the targeted charts arrive; do not call upcoding or a sicker panel on this evidence alone.
